model: A causal passive standard-linear-solid working model with relaxation modulus G(t)=G_inf+(G_0-G_inf)*exp(-t/tau_relax),t>=0,G_0>G_inf>0. The listed exact relaxation data share one small-strain,tangent-temperature state. The initial value is directly observed at t=0. No aging,plasticity or extra relaxation branch is allowed.
creep_definition: Creep compliance J(t) is strain response per unit constant stress applied at0under the SAME hereditary constitutive law sigma(t)=integral_0^t G(t-s)*d epsilon(s),including the initial jump in strain. It is not defined as pointwise1/G(t). Infer the relaxation parameters and derive the corresponding step-stress creep response.
target: Return G_0,G_inf,relaxation time,creep retardation time and J(1s)in GPa^-1. Also report the pointwise reciprocal1/G(1s)and whether it equals actual J(1s). A fitted step-strain decay time is not automatically the step-stress retardation time.
scope: Conditional linear viscoelastic response under the stated one-branch model,not a claim about arbitrary measured material memory.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled material/device reporting model;not an experimental assembly or performance claim.
